name: Failed Event Retry & Manual Review Pipeline

nodes.name: Rebuild normalized lead data from payload

parameters.query:
UPDATE raw_events
SET processing_status = 'retrying',
    last_retry_at = NOW(),
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE internal_id = {{ $json.internal_id }};

INSERT INTO workflow_logs (
    event_id,
    step_name,
    status,
    wf_message
)
VALUES (
    {{ $json.internal_id }},
    'retry_started',
    'started',
    'Retry processing started.'
);

SELECT *
FROM raw_events
WHERE internal_id = {{ $json.internal_id }};

SELECT *
FROM raw_events
WHERE processing_status = 'failed'
  AND COALESCE(retry_count, 0) < 3
  AND (
      next_retry_at IS NULL
      OR next_retry_at <= NOW()
  )
ORDER BY created_at ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    {{ $json.event_id }}::int AS event_id,
    '{{ $json.event_external_id }}' AS event_external_id,

    '{{ $json.lead_name }}' AS lead_name,
    '{{ $json.lead_email }}' AS lead_email,
    '{{ $json.lead_phone }}' AS lead_phone,
    '{{ $json.lead_source }}' AS lead_source,

    l.internal_id AS existing_lead_id,
    l.lead_email AS existing_lead_email,

    CASE 
        WHEN l.internal_id IS NOT NULL THEN true
        ELSE false
    END AS lead_exists
FROM (SELECT 1) x
LEFT JOIN leads l
    ON l.lead_email = '{{ $json.lead_email }}'
LIMIT 1;

UPDATE raw_events
SET processing_status = 'completed',
    processed_at = NOW(),
    updated_at = NOW(),
    error_message = NULL
WHERE internal_id = {{ $json.event_id }};

INSERT INTO workflow_logs (
    event_id,
    lead_id,
    step_name,
    status,
    wf_message
)
VALUES (
    {{ $json.event_id }},
    {{ $json.existing_lead_id }},
    'retry_lead_already_exists',
    'success',
    'Lead already exists. Event marked as completed.'
);

UPDATE raw_events
SET processing_status = 'manual_review',
    manual_review_reason = 'Invalid payload during retry',
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE internal_id = {{ $json.event_id }};

INSERT INTO workflow_logs (
    event_id,
    step_name,
    status,
    wf_message
)
VALUES (
    {{ $json.event_id }},
    'retry_validation_failed',
    'failed',
    'Invalid payload during retry. Manual review required.'
);

UPDATE raw_events
SET processing_status = 'failed',
    retry_count = COALESCE(retry_count, 0) + 1,
    last_retry_at = NOW(),
    next_retry_at = NOW() + INTERVAL '15 minutes',
    error_message = '{{ $json.crm_error_message }}',
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE internal_id = {{ $json.event_id }};

INSERT INTO workflow_logs (
    event_id,
    step_name,
    status,
    wf_message
)
VALUES (
    {{ $json.event_id }},
    'retry_failed',
    'failed',
    '{{ $json.crm_error_message }}'
);

WITH inserted_lead AS (
    INSERT INTO leads (
        external_id,
        event_id,
        lead_name,
        lead_email,
        lead_phone,
        lead_source
    )
    VALUES (
        '{{ $json.lead_external_id }}',
        {{ $json.event_id }},
        '{{ $json.lead_name }}',
        '{{ $json.lead_email }}',
        '{{ $json.lead_phone }}',
        '{{ $json.lead_source }}'
    )
    ON CONFLICT (lead_email) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING internal_id
),

resolved_lead AS (
    SELECT internal_id
    FROM inserted_lead

    UNION ALL

    SELECT internal_id
    FROM leads
    WHERE lead_email = '{{ $json.lead_email }}'
    LIMIT 1
),

updated_event AS (
    UPDATE raw_events
    SET processing_status = 'completed',
        processed_at = NOW(),
        updated_at = NOW(),
        error_message = NULL
    WHERE internal_id = {{ $json.event_id }}
    RETURNING internal_id
),

inserted_log AS (
    INSERT INTO workflow_logs (
        event_id,
        lead_id,
        step_name,
        status,
        wf_message
    )
    SELECT
        {{ $json.event_id }},
        resolved_lead.internal_id,
        'retry_success',
        'success',
        'Failed event was successfully reprocessed.'
    FROM resolved_lead
    RETURNING event_id, lead_id
)

SELECT
    resolved_lead.internal_id AS lead_internal_id,
    {{ $json.event_id }} AS event_id,
    '{{ $json.event_external_id }}' AS event_external_id,
    '{{ $json.lead_name }}' AS lead_name,
    '{{ $json.lead_email }}' AS lead_email,
    '{{ $json.lead_phone }}' AS lead_phone,
    '{{ $json.lead_source }}' AS lead_source,
    '{{ $json.lead_external_id }}' AS lead_external_id
FROM resolved_lead;

UPDATE raw_events
SET processing_status = 'manual_review',
    manual_review_reason = COALESCE(error_message, 'Retry limit reached'),
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE internal_id = {{ $json.internal_id }};

INSERT INTO workflow_logs (
    event_id,
    step_name,
    status,
    wf_message
)
VALUES (
    {{ $json.internal_id }},
    'manual_review_required',
    'failed',
    'Retry limit reached. Human review required.'
);

INSERT INTO workflow_logs (
    event_id,
    step_name,
    status,
    wf_message
)
VALUES (
    {{ $('Search manual review candidates').item.json.internal_id }},
    'notification_sent',
    'success',
    'Retries/manual check notification sent.'
);

INSERT INTO workflow_logs (
    event_id,
    step_name,
    status,
    wf_message
)
VALUES (
    {{ $('Rebuild normalized lead data from payload').item.json.event_id }},
    'notification_sent',
    'success',
    'Retries/manual check notification sent.'
);

SELECT *
FROM raw_events
WHERE processing_status = 'failed'
  AND COALESCE(retry_count, 0) >= 3
ORDER BY created_at ASC
LIMIT 10;

INSERT INTO workflow_logs (
    event_id,
    lead_id,
    step_name,
    status,
    wf_message
)
VALUES (
    {{ $('Retry success').item.json.event_id }},
    {{ $('Retry success').item.json.lead_internal_id }},
    'notification_sent',
    'success',
    'Success notification sent.'
);
